name: lean_build
description: Build the Lean project and restart the LSP session. Use only when imports change or rebuilding is needed.

output_lines.description: Tail lines of build output to return (0 = none).

name: lean_check_statement
description: Autoformalization helper: verify that a Lean type / statement elaborates correctly (types check, all names resolve) WITHOUT requiring a proof. Wraps the statement as `theorem _check : <statement> := b

statement.description:
The Lean type / statement to check (e.g. `∀ n : Nat, n + 0 = n`,
`Real.exp 0 = 1`). The tool wraps it as
`theorem _check

imports.description:
Imports to add at the top of the snippet. Defaults to `["Mathlib"]`
so most of Mathlib is in scope.

name: lean_check_visibility
description: Position-aware visibility check: does `<name>` resolve at line `line` of `file_path` given that file's imports / opens / namespace context? Returns the inferred signature, whether the declaration carr

file_path.description:
File whose import / open / namespace scope provides the lookup
context.

line.description:
1-indexed line at which to evaluate visibility. The tool inserts a
`#check @<name>` line before this line.

name.description: Name to look up (qualified or unqualified).

name: lean_code_actions
description: Get LSP code actions for a line. Returns resolved edits for TryThis suggestions (simp?, exact?, apply?) and other quick fixes.

name: lean_completions
description: Get IDE autocompletions. Use on INCOMPLETE code (after `.` or partial name).

name: lean_declaration_file
description: Get file where a symbol is declared. Symbol must be present in file first.

name: lean_diagnostic_messages
description: Get compiler diagnostics (errors, warnings, infos) for a Lean file.

name: lean_explain_error
description: Classify Lean diagnostics by category (type_mismatch / unknown_identifier / failed_to_synthesize / motive_not_type_correct / universe_inconsistency / unsolved_goals / tactic_failed / parse_error / imp

start_line.description:
1-indexed start line. Optional — when omitted, all diagnostics for
the file are returned.

include_warnings.description: Include warnings and infos as well as errors. Default: false.

name: lean_file_outline
description: Get imports and declarations with type signatures. Token-efficient.

name: lean_find_usages
description: Find concrete usage examples of a named declaration (lemma / def / class). Greps the project + stdlib via ripgrep, skips declaration sites, and returns up to `limit` lines showing how the symbol is ac

name.description:
Symbol name; can be fully qualified (`Nat.add_zero`) or unqualified
(`add_zero`). For unqualified queries every dot-qual

name: lean_get_widget_source
description: Get the JavaScript source of a widget by hash. Returns the full JS module; may be large.

name: lean_get_widgets
description: Get panel widgets at a position (proof visualisations, #html, custom widgets). Returns raw widget data; may be large.

name: lean_goal
description: Get proof goals at a position. MOST IMPORTANT tool - use often! Omit `column` to see goals_before (line start) and goals_after (line end), showing how the tactic transforms the state. "no goals" = pro

file_path.description: Absolute or project-root-relative path to a Lean file.

column.description: Optional column (1-indexed). Omit for goals_before / goals_after.

name: lean_goal_diff
description: Structured diff between two proof states. Compare the goal at `before_line` (typically the line before a tactic) with the goal at `after_line` (typically the line after). Returns added / removed / ret

before_column.description:
Optional explicit columns (1-indexed UTF-16). Default for each: end
of the line.

name: lean_hammer_premise
description: Get premise suggestions for automation tactics at a goal position. Returns lemma names suitable for `simp only [...]`, `aesop`, or hints.

name: lean_hover_info
description: Get type signature and docs for a symbol at a position.

name: lean_leanfinder
description: Semantic search by mathematical meaning via Lean Finder (HuggingFace).

name: lean_leansearch
description: Search Mathlib via leansearch.net using natural language. Examples: "Cauchy-Schwarz inequality", "sum of two even numbers is even".

name: lean_list_sorries
description: Enumerate every proof-placeholder token in a file — both `sorry` and Lean's synonym `admit` (skipping comments, strings, identifier substrings, and escaped identifiers `«sorry»` / `«admit»`). Each ite

include_goals.description:
Also fetch the first goal at each sorry position. Adds one
`$/lean/plainGoal` request per sorry. Default: true.

name: lean_local_search
description: Fast local search to verify declarations exist via ripgrep. Use BEFORE trying a lemma name to make sure it's available in the project.

name: lean_loogle
description: Search Mathlib by type signature via loogle.lean-lang.org. Examples: `Real.sin`, `(?a → ?b) → List ?a → List ?b`.

name: lean_multi_attempt
description: Try multiple tactics without modifying the file on disk. Returns the goal state and diagnostics for each snippet. With `--repl` enabled and a `repl` binary present, snippets are evaluated in tactic mo

stop_on_success.description:
Stop after the first snippet that closes the goal (no remaining goals
AND no error-severity diagnostics on the inserted

name: lean_ping
description: Health check: echo the supplied message and return the server version. Use this to verify the MCP transport is working.

name: lean_profile_proof
description: Run `lean --profile` on a theorem. Returns per-line timing and per-category cumulative time. SLOW — avoid on theorems that already hit heartbeat limits.

name: lean_project_overview
description: Project-level structure summary: every `.lean` module under the project root with its first-line docstring and top-level declaration names. Pure static scan (no LSP), so it stays fast on Mathlib-scale

project_root.description: Override the project root. Defaults to `--lean-project-path`.

max_declarations.description: Per-module cap on how many declaration names to return. Default 32.

include_dependencies.description:
When true, also descend into `.lake/packages/*` (dependency
modules). Default false — Mathlib alone is ~25k modules, tha

name: lean_quick_check
description: Quickly verify a Lean name exists + report its type signature, without attempting any proof. Runs `#check @<name>` through the LSP and parses the info diagnostic. Pair with `lean_local_search` (which

name.description:
Fully qualified or unqualified Lean name to look up (e.g.
`Nat.add_zero`, `Real.exp`).

name: lean_references
description: Find all references to a symbol (including the declaration). Position cursor at the symbol.

name: lean_replace_sorry
description: Replace a single proof placeholder (`sorry` or `admit`, located by 1-indexed line) with a proof. Verifies the edit by diffing pre/post diagnostics (only NEW errors block success) and rejects replaceme

line.description:
1-indexed line of the sorry to replace. Use `lean_list_sorries`
first if you have multiple sorries in the file.

column.description:
Optional 1-indexed UTF-16 column to disambiguate when a single line
contains multiple `sorry` tokens (e.g. the skeleton

proof.description:
Replacement text. May span multiple lines; the existing indent of
the sorry is preserved and applied to every line of `p

persist.description:
If `true` (default), the file is overwritten on disk when the
replacement compiles cleanly. If `false`, the edit is eval

allow_sorries.description:
Opt-in to **skeleton mode**: by default the tool rejects
replacements whose proof text still contains placeholder tokens

name: lean_run_code
description: Run a self-contained Lean snippet (must include imports) and return compiler diagnostics.

code.description: Self-contained Lean code (must include any imports needed).

name: lean_slow_proofs
description: File-level performance audit. Iterates every theorem / lemma / def in a file, runs `lean --profile` per theorem, and returns the slowest `top_n` whose elaboration exceeds `threshold_ms` ms. **Slow**:

top_n.description: Number of slowest theorems to return. Default 5.

threshold_ms.description: Skip theorems whose elaboration time is below this (ms). Default 500.

timeout_per_theorem_secs.description: Per-theorem profiling timeout in seconds. Default 60.

max_theorems_to_profile.description:
Hard cap on how many theorems to profile (safety: each one spawns
a full Lean process). Default 20.

name: lean_state_search
description: Find lemmas that may close the goal at a position. Searches premise-search.com.

name: lean_stuck_helper
description: Comprehensive 'what can close this goal?' helper. Tries a curated tactic list (`rfl`, `decide`, `omega`, `simp_all`, `aesop`, `linarith`, `ring`, `trivial`, `tauto`, `norm_num`), then `exact <h>` for

include_premises.description:
Pull premises from `lean_state_search` and try `exact` / `apply` for
each. Default: true. Set false to skip a network ca

include_progress.description:
Also return tactics that progressed (didn't close) — useful even when
no closer is found. Default: true.

name: lean_suggest_definitions
description: Autoformalization helper: given a natural-language concept (e.g. "derivative of a real function", "polynomial ring"), suggests Mathlib **definitions** that may match. Fans out to leanfinder + leansear

concept.description:
Natural-language description or mixed query, e.g. "derivative of a
real function" or "polynomial ring".

num_results.description: Number of suggestions to return after merging. Default 8.

kinds.description:
Filter to these declaration kinds. Default:
["def","class","structure","inductive","abbrev"]. Pass an empty
list to disa

name: lean_tactic_stats
description: Count tactic-name occurrences across a file (static scan; no elaboration). Returns the most-used tactic identifiers sorted by count. Useful for self-reflection ("am I leaning too heavily on `simp_all`

limit.description: Max distinct tactic names to return. Default 20.

name: lean_term_goal
description: Get the expected type at a position.

name: lean_verify
description: Check the axioms a theorem depends on + optionally scan the source file for suspicious patterns (unsafe, @[extern], opaque, etc.).
